title: Automated Breaking Change Migrations via AST Codemods (jscodeshift)
subtopicTitle: Automated Breaking Change Migrations via AST Codemods (jscodeshift)
problemStatement:
Writing automated JavaScript/TypeScript AST codemods with jscodeshift to migrate thousands of files when breaking API changes are unavoidable.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Staff frontend engineers don't ask 50 teams to manually refactor props; they ship an automated codemod that refactors their code in 10 seconds.
interviewTrap: Using regex find-and-replace to migrate code, which breaks on multiline props, comments, and variable renames.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Code -> AST Parser (Babel/Recast) -> Find Component Nodes -> Mutate Prop Names or Structure -> Code Generator (preserving formatting).
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.

complexity.time: O(1) CSS variable resolution at paint time / zero JavaScript runtime overhead
complexity.space: O(1) bundle footprint per imported component
